readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Taurus: The change that's coming is smaller than your resistance to it suggests. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: The idea you dismissed too quickly deserves another look. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: Your intuition is more accurate than your analysis right now. Trust the feeling. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Leo: The warmth you've been rationing — release it. You have more than enough. Let this one be easy.
readings.Virgo: There is a small pleasure available to you right now that your efficiency has been routing around. Take it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: Your desire for fairness is genuine. In this situation, fairness and kindness are not the same thing. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Scorpio: Something ended. You don't have to perform recovery for anyone. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you're moving toward at full speed would benefit from a slightly adjusted trajectory. Small correction now. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Capricorn: Someone you respect is watching and taking notes. Good. You know what you're doing. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Aquarius: You need more freedom than average. This is not a flaw. It is a condition that needs to be communicated. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Pisces: Your inner life is extraordinarily rich. The outer life sometimes doesn't know what to do with it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
